title: 春节 — Chinese New Year
summary: Cultural text about the most important festival in China: the Spring Festival.

paragraphs.hanzi: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
paragraphs.pinyin: chūnjié shì zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de jiérì.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄔㄨㄣㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄕˋ ㄓㄨㄥㄍㄨㄛˊ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄨㄥˋㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄝˊㄖˋ.
paragraphs.translation: The Spring Festival is the most important holiday in China.
paragraphs.text: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
paragraphs.romanization: chūnjié shì zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de jiérì.
paragraphs.translation_en: The Spring Festival is the most important holiday in China.
paragraphs.translation_id: Festival Musim Semi adalah hari libur terpenting di Tiongkok.

paragraphs.hanzi: 春节的时候，人们回家看爸爸妈妈。
paragraphs.pinyin: chūnjié de shíhou, rénmen huí jiā kàn bàba māma.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄔㄨㄣㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˊㄏㄡ˙, ㄖㄣˊㄇㄣ˙ ㄏㄨㄟˊ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄎㄢˋ ㄅㄚˋㄅㄚ˙ ㄇㄚㄇㄚ˙.
paragraphs.translation: During the New Year, people go home to see their parents.
paragraphs.text: 春节的时候，人们回家看爸爸妈妈。
paragraphs.romanization: chūnjié de shíhou, rénmen huí jiā kàn bàba māma.
paragraphs.translation_en: During the New Year, people go home to see their parents.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saat Tahun Baru, orang-orang pulang ke rumah untuk menemui orang tua mereka.

paragraphs.hanzi: 大家一起吃饭，孩子们有红包。
paragraphs.pinyin: dàjiā yìqǐ chīfàn, háizimen yǒu hóngbāo.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄉㄚˋㄐㄧㄚ ㄧˋㄑㄧˇ ㄔㄈㄢˋ, ㄏㄞˊㄗ˙ㄇㄣ˙ ㄧㄡˇ ㄏㄨㄥˊㄅㄠ.
paragraphs.translation: Everyone eats together and the children receive red envelopes.
paragraphs.text: 大家一起吃饭，孩子们有红包。
paragraphs.romanization: dàjiā yìqǐ chīfàn, háizimen yǒu hóngbāo.
paragraphs.translation_en: Everyone eats together and the children receive red envelopes.
paragraphs.translation_id: Semua makan bersama dan anak-anak menerima angpao.

title: 为什么学汉语 — Why study Chinese
summary: Adapted text about the reasons to learn Chinese today.

paragraphs.pinyin: xiànzài hěn duō rén xuéxí hànyǔ.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄧㄢˋㄗㄞˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄖㄣˊ ㄒㄩㄝˊㄒㄧˊ ㄏㄢˋㄩˇ.
paragraphs.romanization: xiànzài hěn duō rén xuéxí hànyǔ.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sekarang banyak orang belajar bahasa Mandarin.

paragraphs.hanzi: 有的人因为工作，有的人因为喜欢中国文化。
paragraphs.pinyin: yǒude rén yīnwèi gōngzuò, yǒude rén yīnwèi xǐhuan zhōngguó wénhuà.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄧㄡˇㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ㄧㄣㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄨㄥㄗㄨㄛˋ, ㄧㄡˇㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ㄧㄣㄨㄟˋ ㄒㄧˇㄏㄨㄢ˙ ㄓㄨㄥㄍㄨㄛˊ ㄨㄣˊㄏㄨㄚˋ.
paragraphs.translation: Some for work, others because they like Chinese culture.
paragraphs.text: 有的人因为工作，有的人因为喜欢中国文化。
paragraphs.romanization: yǒude rén yīnwèi gōngzuò, yǒude rén yīnwèi xǐhuan zhōngguó wénhuà.
paragraphs.translation_en: Some for work, others because they like Chinese culture.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ada yang untuk pekerjaan, ada juga karena suka budaya Tiongkok.

paragraphs.hanzi: 汉语不容易，可是很有意思。
paragraphs.pinyin: hànyǔ bù róngyì, kěshì hěn yǒuyìsi.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄏㄢˋㄩˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄖㄨㄥˊㄧˋ, ㄎㄜˇㄕˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄧㄡˇㄧˋㄙ˙.
paragraphs.translation: Chinese isn't easy, but it's very interesting.
paragraphs.text: 汉语不容易，可是很有意思。
paragraphs.romanization: hànyǔ bù róngyì, kěshì hěn yǒuyìsi.
paragraphs.translation_en: Chinese isn't easy, but it's very interesting.
paragraphs.translation_id: Bahasa Mandarin tidak mudah, tapi sangat menarik.

paragraphs.hanzi: 每天学习一点儿，就会越来越好。
paragraphs.pinyin: měitiān xuéxí yìdiǎnr, jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄇㄟˇㄊㄧㄢ ㄒㄩㄝˊㄒㄧˊ ㄧˋㄉㄧㄢˇㄦ˙, ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄩㄝˋㄌㄞˊㄩㄝˋ ㄏㄠˇ.
paragraphs.translation: Studying a little bit every day, you get better and better.
paragraphs.text: 每天学习一点儿，就会越来越好。
paragraphs.romanization: měitiān xuéxí yìdiǎnr, jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo.
paragraphs.translation_en: Studying a little bit every day, you get better and better.
paragraphs.translation_id: Belajar sedikit setiap hari, kemampuanmu makin baik.

title: 自己 — oneself; one's own
summary: A short passage about oneself; one's own.
summary_en: A short passage about oneself; one's own.

paragraphs.text: 她在人群中一眼认出了自己的老同学。
paragraphs.hanzi: 她在人群中一眼认出了自己的老同学。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā zài rén qún zhōng yī yǎn rèn chū le zì jǐ de lǎo tóng xué 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄗㄞˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄑㄩㄣˊ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄧ ㄧㄢˇ ㄖㄣˋ ㄔㄨ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄌㄠˇ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄩㄝˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā zài rénqún zhōng yì yǎn rèn chū le zìjǐ de lǎo tóngxué.
paragraphs.translation: She recognised her old classmate at a glance in the crowd.
paragraphs.translation_en: She recognised her old classmate at a glance in the crowd.
paragraphs.translation_id: Polisi segera mengevakuasi massa ke tempat aman.

paragraphs.text: 他觉得自己的字写得很丑，所以不好意思给别人看。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他觉得自己的字写得很丑，所以不好意思给别人看。

paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄗˋ ㄒㄧㄝˇ ㄉㄜˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄔㄡˇ ， ㄙㄨㄛˇ ㄧˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄧˋ ㄙ ㄍㄟˇ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄎㄢˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā juéde zìjǐ de zì xiě de hěn chǒu, suǒyǐ bù hǎoyìsi gěi biérén kàn.
